overview: We take real questions from your customers or staff, run them through your AI tool and score each answer for accuracy, tone and safety. You get a scored report, a list of fixes made and a test set you can run again after any future change.

faq: Where do the test questions come from?

Mostly from you: past chats, support emails and search logs. If you have little, we write realistic questions with you and add tricky ones. We never use real customers' personal details in the report.
Can you test without seeing customer data?
Yes. You can strip names and emails first, or give us only the question text. We only need the wording of each question and, if possible, the answer you would want.
Will you change my AI tool?
Only the parts you allow, usually its instructions, settings or source content. We list every change and keep the old version so you can go back.
Do you test voice or images?
Text is the default. Image questions can be tested if your tool accepts pictures. Voice tools are tested through their written transcript. Tell us what you use in the form.
